title: French supermarket giant's shares plunge 14% after warning ‘unprecedented’ unrest will hit business
summary: Carrefour, the French supermarket giant, has announced a significant cut to its financial forecasts for the year 2026, attributing this decision to the escalating social unrest and deteriorating security conditions in France. The company expressed concerns that these factors are adversely impacting consumer spending, leading to a 14% plunge in its shares. This unprecedented unrest poses challenges not only for Carrefour but also for the broader retail sector in the country, as businesses grapple with the implications of such instability.
